walkthroughs.body_html:
Painting and Mixed Media — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Painting and Mixed Media brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Painting and Mixed Media.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What attitude does Pop Art take toward consumer culture?
options: Cool colours like blue.
It rejects all modern imagery.
It straightforwardly celebrates capitalism.
Ambiguous - it both celebrates and critiques mass media imagery.
